featured_reviews.name: sakshi rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a great experience with Shaadiyaadgar for our wedding photography! What really stood out was their transparency and guidance in helping us choose the most suitable package for our wedding, considering our functions, guest count and overall vision so we got the best value.

Their team was patient, involved, and attentive throughout the event, guiding and capturing all the special moments beautifully. They were also very responsive to our needs, taking the time to understand our requirements for edits, and ensuring we were content with the final deliverables!

featured_reviews.name: Suraiya Laskar
featured_reviews.review_text: ShaadiYaadgar had given me the best experience by capturing my beautiful wedding moments and executing those in a extraordinary manner possible. Starting from the pictures, editing, video, each and everything was just so good. the special mention I would give to the photo editing team and their speed of response for each and every service provided. Last but not the least, Thank you ShaadiYaadgar team for making our wedding moments more special  & memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Diksha Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently hired Shaadiyaadgar for my wedding photography needs, and I couldn't be happier with the results.
From the moment I reached out to them, the team at Shaadiyaadgar was extremely professional and responsive. Ketan, the owner, was personally involved in coordinating all the details and ensuring everything ran smoothly. Shristi, the Editing Head, did an outstanding job in editing my photos, delivering stunning results that surpassed my expectations.
Shaadiyaadgar offers a wide range of services, and I opted for traditional photography, candid photography, and cinematography. The team was well-prepared and captured every moment beautifully. They also provided drone photography and videography, which added a unique perspective to my wedding album.
One aspect that really impressed me was their commitment to being fast and reliable. They arrived at the venue before time and efficiently managed their team of photographers. After the event, they promptly delivered the edited photos, allowing me to share them on social media right away.
If you're looking for wedding and pre-wedding photography in Mumbai, I highly recommend Shaadiyaadgar. You can trust them to capture all the precious moments of your big day with utmost professionalism and creativity. I'm extremely grateful to Ketan, Shristi, and the entire team for making my wedding memories truly unforgettable!

featured_reviews.name: Vaishnavi Farakte
featured_reviews.review_text: We hired Shaadiyaadgar for candid photography and were blown away by the quality of their work. Ketan and his team captured the most genuine and heartfelt moments effortlessly. The fast delivery and stunning edits made it a pleasure to relive our special day. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Tripathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with a professional photography service in
Mumbai for my wedding and pre-wedding needs, and I couldn't be happier with the
results. The team demonstrated remarkable skill and expertise in capturing the most
precious moments of our special day. Their fast delivery and stunning edits made it
effortless to share our memories with friends and family. Highly recommended for

featured_reviews.name: Avi
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the pleasure of working with the ShaadiYaadgar team recently on a big event. When I first spoke to them, I made my requirements rather straightforward, I wanted them to recommend a venue, and to provide expert photography and videography services too. Khetan made all aspects of the planning very easy with excellent suggestions. Khetan was also professional on all aspects relating to payments. On the day of the event, the ShaadiYaadgar team blew me away with their creativity and drive for perfection. They treated me with great care and made the event a truly memorable one. As for the end product, the way they craft their photos and videos is beautiful. I did not dictate anything to them, they had full creative freedom and the end products were stunning. The videos are cinematic with outstanding backing audio tracks. I would recommend ShaadiYaadgar to anyone looking for expert phot/video services and event planning, they truly care for their customers and they have left a long lasting impression on me. I cannot wait to use them again in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the best experience with The Lightsmiths capturing our wedding pictures and videos. Vibhuti and the team were an absolute pleasure to work with. They beautifully captured the intimate moments between my husband and me, making us feel incredibly comfortable throughout the entire process.

The photographs were stunning, and the video was exceptional, featuring a perfect blend of traditional music for our South Indian wedding and modern tunes for the reception. Our family and loved ones adore the video, and it has quickly become a cherished keepsake. We are so grateful for their talent and professionalism.

Highly recommend The Lightsmiths for anyone looking to preserve their special moments!

featured_reviews.name: Natasha Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Planning a wedding is stressful, but working with Vibhuti and Rahul is the opposite. From the moment we met them (and I locked them down at the very beginning!) they became my favourite people throughout the entire process.

They and their team are some of the kindest souls you’ll come across, and their talent truly speaks for itself. The photos and videos they captured went far beyond anything I had imagined. More than that, they made everyone, including my camera-shy husband, feel completely at ease. We actually had fun being photographed for our portraits! By the end of the wedding, it really felt like they were part of the family.

They documented our celebrations in the most dreamy and beautiful way. I can still feel all the joy, emotion, and celebration when I look back at it all. Every photo feels like it holds a memory, not just a moment. Our friends and family have also been loving the pictures and videos, and I couldn’t be more grateful.

Amid all the wedding chaos, they were a calming presence, especially Vibhuti. She helped me pause, breathe, and take it all in — something I’ll always be thankful for.

It honestly felt like two of our close friends were capturing our wedding. And even now, we’re still connected. I’d recommend them in a heartbeat. They’re truly something special.

featured_reviews.name: Vaidehi Dhoot
featured_reviews.review_text:
We couldn’t be more thrilled with the incredible work Vibhuti & Rahul at The Lightsmiths did for our wedding! From the moment we met, they made us feel comfortable and listened to every detail of what we envisioned for our big day. Their professionalism and creativity shone through every shot, capturing all the love, laughter, and unforgettable moments in the most beautiful and artistic way.

The final video was beyond our expectations—it felt like reliving our wedding day all over again. Every time we watch it (even now 10 years post our wedding) we’re transported back to the emotions and joy of that special day. They didn’t just capture the event; they told our story perfectly, with all the little touches that made the day unique to us.

Thank you so much for your amazing talent, patience, and dedication. We will cherish this video for a lifetime!

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with The Lightsmiths for my wedding photography & videos was an amazing experience! They took the time to understand our taste & needs for the style of photographs beforehand & were very flexible & understanding in the lead up to the wedding.

Through the wedding days, they managed to capture all the best moments and were present without being intrusive and also providing lots of advice along the way.

The end products with the photos and videos has been mind blowing!! The final video that they have shared has captured all the right moments and feelings, while really being an extremely well edited video. Our friends and family still give us loads of compliments on it

Highly recommend working with The Lightsmiths to capture your special days in the best way!

featured_reviews.name: gargi panwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had already seen their work when they had filmed and photographed our friends wedding and we were just blown away by their art!!! Their photography is like an art because it  immerses you in the world created through their lens!!!
We had such a great experience with them!! It’s been 9 years since I’m married and when I still see my wedding film I feel awed because it’s too precious and beautifully made! Thank you guys… love you 💗

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil John
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of having The Lightsmiths cover my wedding last February, and I can confidently say they exceeded all expectations. From the very beginning, their professionalism and passion for their craft were evident. They have a remarkable ability to blend into the background, capturing the most candid and genuine moments without ever feeling intrusive.

The quality of their photography is nothing short of superb. They masterfully balanced candid shots with technical precision, ensuring that every photo was not only a beautiful memory but also a work of art. The attention to detail in each frame, the play of light and shadows, and the natural expressions they captured were truly remarkable.What stood out the most was their commitment to making us feel comfortable and relaxed throughout the day. Their friendly and approachable nature made it easy to forget the camera was even there, allowing for the most authentic moments to be captured.

They were also incredibly flexible and accommodating to our requests, which made the entire experience seamless and stress-free.

The final photos were delivered promptly, and the quality was exceptional. Each image told a story, beautifully encapsulating the emotions and joy of our special day. We have received countless compliments on our wedding photos, and we owe it all to The Lightsmiths.

featured_reviews.name: Panchami Ghavri
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Lightsmiths did the videography for our wedding in Sri Lanka. We had the best experience working with them. They have become an integral part of our story almost like family to me and vish and our families. Both Rahul and Vibhuti got the brief pretty much from the time we met, they cut the most wonderful footage for our wedding video!
We highly recommend! Complete no brainer :)
Thank you to both of you for the momories!

Panch & Vish

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Rubina Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across The Lightsmiths when I happened to see one of their videos online & I exclaimed “That’s how a Wedding is Shot!!!"

From the first time I called them, I felt an instant connection with Vibhuti. She was patient, listened to exactly what I wanted & I was instantly at peace because I knew, I have made the right choice & boy!! Did they deliver!!

They were punctual, (actually, earlier than the time that I needed them to be there ), happy and so so comfortable to work with. They were not people who were filming our wedding. They became a part of our family who also happened to film our wedding! They blended so well. They checked up on me, my husband, my family and went over and beyond with what I expected from them.

When we received our videos we could not have been happier. From the short film, to the long film, the videos were captured so so so so beautifully .. when you’re busy being the bride and groom it all goes by in a flash and there are so many bits you miss, so watching the film, interviews and seeing some of the behind the scenes was absolutely fantastic. We will forever treasure our videos, they made us laugh and cry happy tears and bring out so many emotions. I can’t thank them enough !!

If you are considering getting your wedding filmed – absolutely do so! They will NOT let you down !

featured_reviews.name: Hutoxi Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Ever since my father discovered Liberty Photo Arts decades ago, we have not needed to look anywhere else for any photography needs. Be it our college or office IDs, or passports and visa photos and tons of holiday trips photos, this family-run business, most conveniently located at 5 minutes walking distance from VT Station, Rajeshbhai did it all for my family for years, helped by loyal-till-today Jayantbhai. Those hundreds of photos are as vivid today as ever, precious unforgettable memories. Now his young son Devang is efficiently and enthusiastically carrying forward the business and it's a pleasure to see his smiling, kindly mother also sitting at the shop to help out. They are patient, hardworking and take a lot of trouble to be perfect till the customer is completely satisfied. Their rates are reasonable too. Two recent examples: 1.After the Covid-lockdown had eased and I needed some photos printed even though the shop was not open regularly, they made sure that the prints were delivered to me through neighbouring establishments, from where I could pick them up at my convenience. 2.Recently I wanted a print of an old picture on an ancient, rusty biscuit tin. 'Liberty' exceeded all my expectations and produced a wonderful copy after painstaking efforts and even framed it for me. In both these instances, Devang played a huge part in organising, corresponding and doing the needful with much patience, understanding and hard work. I surely commend Liberty Photo Arts to anyone for any photography needs anytime. Thank you 'Liberty'.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Liberty Photo Arts were appointed to click pics at the birthday party of the daughter of my nephew Mr Rahul Raje  owner of a logistics business.
I attended this party and was impressed by the manner in which Liberty Photo picked up the relevant events and clicked them in their cameras. They encouraged the guests to display attractive poses with the result the photos came out very well. These were even framed instantly and given to the persons appearing in the photos. Must say a nice gesture. No doubt these photos will be a good memory for posterity and will later help in taking us down the memory lane.
Thanks Liberty for your nice professional effort.  It added spice to the wonderful function organized by my nephew Rahul Raje.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Dhanak
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the absolute pleasure of working with Frames and Emotions for our wedding. Darshan and his team were absolutely warm and made sure all of our moments are captured beautifully.

They captured not just the big moments, but also the subtle emotions and candid memories that made our day so special. The attention to detail, creativity in composition, and overall aesthetic truly brought our story to life in every frame.

The pre wedding experience was also great and team really went out of the way.

Beyond the photos themselves, the team was punctual, responsive, and extremely well-coordinated throughout all our events.

Thank you for helping us preserve the most important day of our lives so beautifully!

featured_reviews.name: Chaitali Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Darshan and his team are exceptionally best. Having to plan our wedding in India while staying US has its own challenges but I think the best decision we made in the entire wedding was to have Darshan and his team shoot our big day. The pictures and the video edits from the wedding are just so magical and dreamy😍✨

I highly recommend to have Darshan & his team capture big moments of your life!

featured_reviews.name: Rutu Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Darshan and his team did a fantastic job capturing my wedding and pre wedding functions. The entire crew was so enthusiastic and so good at their job. They created such wonderful memories for us. Would totally recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Ronak Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: Wow, where do I even start with Darshan & team? They were hands down the MVP of our wedding day! From cracking jokes to calm our nerves to capturing those Instagram-worthy shots, they did it all with such ease and flair. We felt like we were just hanging out with a friend who happened to have a camera – except this friend was insanely talented! They managed to snap all the right moments without us even noticing, and the end result? Pure magic. Seriously, if you want someone who not only takes amazing photos but also adds that extra sprinkle of fun and personality to your day, Darshan is your go-to. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

featured_reviews.name: Jimit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We got our entire pre wedding, wedding, maternity and baby shoot.. technically all major life events done through Darshan and his team. One just doesn't need to worry about having the best moments of the life being captured, As it is done in the most beautiful way possible. Blends with the family to get the best candid shots on all the occasions. Perfectionist and honest. Punctual and hard working. I'm sure he has stretched above and beyond for every project. Always upgrading gadgets and trand setter. Without a doubt, best in the business.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Punjabi-Anandani
featured_reviews.review_text: They are extremely professional and a knowledgeable team. They did my pre-wedding photoshoot and wedding photography along with videos. Darshan knows exactly what you want and how to get it done. He is clear and concise with his approach. He actually met with our venue decorator to even understand her perspective and give his thoughts for lighting so that our images come neat. This helped everyone a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Undale
featured_reviews.review_text: I highly recommend Darshan and his team. They are creative and very easy to talk to. I was really worried for my wedding photography asbi am very shy. But they team was very cooperative and our photos came out amazing.
